title: Chris Foerster: Coaching the 49ers in Kyle Shanahan's absence is "really a group thing"

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Chris Foerster: Coaching the 49ers in Kyle Shanahan's absence is "really a group thing"
sources.description: With 49ers coach Kyle Shanahan limited at training camp due to a severe concussion suffered in a recent car accident, assistant head coach/offensive line Chris Foerster is running the team.
